measurements.label: P1.O03.observed_blade_extent
measurements.scope: Reconstructed upper narrow blade portion; the thin dry terminal tip is not included. Magnified source review shows the thin dry terminal tip extends beyond this reconstructed endpoint. This is partial observed extent, not whole-leaf length, so no reference residual is computed.

measurements.label: P3.O03.blade_chord
measurements.scope: Oval blade lowest visible basal-lamina junction to terminal margin straight chord candidate. Basal small-lobe/petiole convention remains tentative. The operator length is not independently photo-readable; this explicitly conditional comparison does not establish the measurement definition or physical accuracy.

measurements.label: P5.O04.terminal_lamina_chord
measurements.scope: Visible terminal lamina portion only; basal lobes/petiole-side origin are not included. Ruler image includes basal lobes down toward a small low lobe at its zero. This raw terminal-lamina origin cannot be substituted for that ruler origin; no residual is meaningful.
